summary: Reviewed all weekly candidates with independent web verification. Approved three completed ownership changes: CarTrawler and Layla to Expedia Group, and SheerLuxe to Future plc. Rejected TheFork, easyJet, Aroma-Zone, and Hain International/Hain Celestial UK-Europe brands because the cited evidence showed pending, announced, exclusivity, or portfolio-level transactions rather than completed transfers of control as of 2026-09-26.

approved_deals.direct_owner: CarTrawler, part of Expedia Group B2B
approved_deals.one_line_summary: Expedia Group completed its acquisition of Dublin-based mobility and insurtech travel platform CarTrawler on 2026-09-01.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: Official Expedia Group completion post states that Expedia Group completed the acquisition of CarTrawler and that CarTrawler is now part of Expedia Group B2B. The prior May 2026 Expedia release identified CarTrawler as an Ireland-based B2B platform headquartered in Dublin, providing car rental, ground transport and insurtech solutions to travel brands and travelers.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Completed acquisition is explicitly confirmed by an official Expedia Group source dated 2026-09-01; the resulting owner is Expedia Group. No existing row was found, and no later ownership change was identified in verification.

sources.title: Expedia Group completes CarTrawler acquisition
sources.summary: Official Expedia Group post states that Expedia Group completed its acquisition of CarTrawler, an Ireland-based B2B travel platform, and that CarTrawler is now part of Expedia Group B2B.

sources.title: Expedia Group announces agreement to acquire CarTrawler, advancing strategy to build the most complete B2B travel platform
sources.summary: Official announcement identifies CarTrawler as an Ireland-based B2B platform headquartered in Dublin and describes its mobility and insurtech services for travel partners and travelers.

approved_deals.direct_owner: Layla AI GmbH / Layla, owned by Expedia Group
approved_deals.one_line_summary: Expedia Group acquired Berlin-based AI trip-planning and booking platform Layla on 2026-07-31.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: Expedia Group’s official release states that it acquired Layla, an AI-native trip planning and booking platform. The same release describes Layla as based in Berlin, Germany and founded in 2023. Legal-adviser coverage identifies the target as Layla AI GmbH.
approved_deals.approval_reason: Completed acquisition is stated directly in an official Expedia Group release dated 2026-07-31; the resulting owner is Expedia Group. No duplicate or superseded existing row was found.

sources.title: Expedia Group acquires Layla, accelerating its AI-powered trip planning and booking strategy
sources.summary: Official Expedia Group release states that Expedia Group acquired Layla, an AI-native trip planning and booking platform, and describes Layla as based in Berlin, Germany.

sources.title: Noerr advises Expedia Group on acquisition of Layla AI
sources.summary: Legal-adviser release identifies the acquired target as Layla AI GmbH and reiterates that Expedia Group acquired the Berlin-based AI-native trip-planning and booking platform.

approved_deals.one_line_summary: Future plc acquired 100% of SheerLuxe in January 2026, with Companies House filings showing Future Publishing Limited control from 2026-01-21.
approved_deals.ownership_notes: Future’s official acquisition announcement and PDF describe the purchase of 100% of SheerLuxe. Future’s half-year results state that Future Publishing Limited acquired 100% of the issued share capital and voting rights of SheerLuxe Ltd, SheerLuxe ME FZ and Blush Talent Management Limited on 2026-01-21. Companies House filings show Future Publishing Limited becoming a person with significant control on 2026-01-21.
approved_deals.approval_reason: The acquisition is completed and supported by Future plc official investor materials and UK Companies House filings. No existing ownership row for SheerLuxe was found.

sources.title: Future Acquires SheerLuxe
sources.summary: Future plc announced the acquisition of SheerLuxe, a UK-based digital publishing group focused on fashion, beauty and lifestyle content.

sources.title: Acquisition of SheerLuxe
sources.summary: Future plc investor PDF states the acquisition was to acquire 100% of SheerLuxe for initial cash consideration of £39.9 million, and describes SheerLuxe as a UK digital publisher in women’s fashion and lifestyle.

sources.title: SHEERLUXE LIMITED filing history
sources.summary: UK Companies House filing history shows notification of Future Publishing Limited as a person with significant control of SheerLuxe Limited on 2026-01-21 and cessation of the prior PSC on the same date.

sources.title: 2026 Half Year Results
sources.summary: Future’s half-year results state that on 2026-01-21 Future Publishing Limited acquired 100% of the issued share capital and voting rights of SheerLuxe Ltd, SheerLuxe ME FZ and Blush Talent Management Limited.

rejected_candidates.reason: Rejected for approval because the transaction was not completed as of verification. Tripadvisor’s 2026-06-15 release described a proposed sale expected to close before the end of 2026, subject to works council consultation, customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals; a later SEC exhibit described the sale as pending and still subject to customary closing conditions including regulatory approvals.

Rejected for approval because the Apollo/Eagle Bidco transaction remains pending. easyJet’s own takeover update states that the scheme document deadline was extended to 2026-10-15, meetings were expected around 2026-11-09, and completion was expected by the end of Q1 2027. This is not a completed transfer of control.

Rejected for approval because the cited Partners Group and Eurazeo materials describe exclusivity and a contemplated majority acquisition, not a completed closing. The language says Partners Group entered into exclusivity with a view to acquiring Aroma-Zone and that the acquisition would be completed through Partners Group’s direct private equity program.

rejected_candidates.brand: Hain International / Hain Celestial UK and Europe brands
rejected_candidates.reason: Rejected for approval because Hain Celestial and AURELIUS materials describe a definitive agreement/agreed acquisition expected to close by the end of 2026, subject to closing conditions including regulatory approvals and a credit-agreement amendment. In addition, the candidate is portfolio/business-level rather than a normalized single consumer brand row.
